color.description_ko: 지정 대상·영역의 색과 색 배치: 전역 색 보정·HDR과 구별; 배경 색을 주체 색으로 바꾸지 않음

includes: Owned local colors and bounded color arrangements, separate from whole-image grading.

color_grading.description: Image-wide or specified tonal-band color and tone transformations, preserving locked local colors.
color_grading.description_ko: 이미지 전체 또는 지정 톤 대역의 색·톤 변환: 대상의 실제 고유색과 구별; 잠긴 영역 색을 덮어쓰지 않음
excludes: 대상의 실제 고유색과 구별; 잠긴 영역 색을 덮어쓰지 않음
includes: Image-wide or specified tonal-band color and tone transformations, preserving locked local colors.

concept_tension.description: A declared conceptual contrast embodied by identifiable owners or states, not an unsupported abstract label.
concept_tension.description_ko: 함께 나타난 개념·상태 간 의미 대비: 한 인물의 반응 대비와 구별; 추상 대비에 실제 소유자·표현 근거 필요
excludes: 한 인물의 반응 대비와 구별; 추상 대비에 실제 소유자·표현 근거 필요
includes: A declared conceptual contrast embodied by identifiable owners or states, not an unsupported abstract label.

declared_person_background.description: Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.
declared_person_background.description_ko: 명시된 인물 배경 맥락: 국가 출신은 외모로 확인할 수 없음; 얼굴 특징·국적을 서로 추론하지 않음
excludes: 국가 출신은 외모로 확인할 수 없음; 얼굴 특징·국적을 서로 추론하지 않음
includes: Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.

depth_of_field.description: Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.
depth_of_field.description_ko: 심도: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.

exposure.description: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.
exposure.description_ko: 기록 노출과 톤 범위: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.

expression.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
expression.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

facial_geometry.description: Owned facial shape, local anatomical geometry and proportions, separate from cosmetic contour or skin finish.
facial_geometry.description_ko: 얼굴 윤곽·부위 형태·비례: 모든 후보가 둘의 관계는 아님; 피부 마감·화장 명암과 실제 형상 구별
excludes: 모든 후보가 둘의 관계는 아님; 피부 마감·화장 명암과 실제 형상 구별
includes: Owned facial shape, local anatomical geometry and proportions, separate from cosmetic contour or skin finish.

film_emulation.description: A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.
film_emulation.description_ko: 선택한 필름 계열의 복합 영상 표현: 입자 하나는 grain_profile; 실제 필름 사용 여부와 모사 외관을 구별
excludes: 입자 하나는 grain_profile; 실제 필름 사용 여부와 모사 외관을 구별
includes: A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.

focus.description: Placement and priority of the focus plane and relative sharpness of named planes.
focus.description_ko: 선명도 우선순위와 초점면 관계: 시선 목표·감각적 주목과 구별; 두 깊이 평면의 상대 선명도 명시
excludes: 시선 목표·감각적 주목과 구별; 두 깊이 평면의 상대 선명도 명시
includes: Placement and priority of the focus plane and relative sharpness of named planes.

format.description: Image aspect ratio and output or display container, distinct from crop-safe composition and media appearance.
format.description_ko: 이미지 비율과 물리·출력 형식: UI-safe 영역은 platform_framing; VHS 외관은 매체 표현
excludes: UI-safe 영역은 platform_framing; VHS 외관은 매체 표현
includes: Image aspect ratio and output or display container, distinct from crop-safe composition and media appearance.

genre.description: Photographic genre and the conventions of the work, distinct from equipment and world rules.
genre.description_ko: 사진 작업의 장르와 표현 관습: 매체·세계 규칙·개별 촬영 장치와 구별; 현재 여러 분류가 섞임
excludes: 매체·세계 규칙·개별 촬영 장치와 구별; 현재 여러 분류가 섞임
includes: Photographic genre and the conventions of the work, distinct from equipment and world rules.

grain_profile.description: Grain or stochastic noise distribution on the image plane, not physical material grain or airborne dust.
grain_profile.description_ko: 이미지 면의 입자와 노이즈 분포: 표면 질감·공기 먼지·렌즈 먼지와 구별
excludes: 표면 질감·공기 먼지·렌즈 먼지와 구별
includes: Grain or stochastic noise distribution on the image plane, not physical material grain or airborne dust.

historical_period.description: Explicit historical or future period as scene context, separate from nostalgic color grading.
historical_period.description_ko: 시대 배경: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit historical or future period as scene context, separate from nostalgic color grading.

image_artifact.description: Encoding, scanning, signal or processing artifacts on the image plane, separate from optical effects and scene surfaces.
image_artifact.description_ko: 매체와 인코딩 흔적: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Encoding, scanning, signal or processing artifacts on the image plane, separate from optical effects and scene surfaces.

image_detail.description: Recorded detail, acuity and edge rendering, distinct from physical realism claims and focus-plane placement.
image_detail.description_ko: 영상 세부와 선명도: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Recorded detail, acuity and edge rendering, distinct from physical realism claims and focus-plane placement.

lens.description: Declared lens optics and projection characteristics, distinct from camera distance and chosen focus planes.
lens.description_ko: 렌즈 선택과 투영 특성: 초점거리 효과와 장치 정체를 혼동하지 않음; 초점면은 focus
excludes: 초점거리 효과와 장치 정체를 혼동하지 않음; 초점면은 focus
includes: Declared lens optics and projection characteristics, distinct from camera distance and chosen focus planes.

lens_artifact.description: Image effects arising along the optical path, distinct from physical scene particles and encoding damage.
lens_artifact.description_ko: 광학 경로와 이미지 면에 생긴 영상 흔적: 환경 속 입자 자체와 구별; 긴 노출·광학 flare·매체 압축의 분리 범위 검토
excludes: 환경 속 입자 자체와 구별; 긴 노출·광학 flare·매체 압축의 분리 범위 검토
includes: Image effects arising along the optical path, distinct from physical scene particles and encoding damage.

light_color.description: Color or color-temperature relation of declared illumination and its receivers, separate from local pigment or grading.
light_color.description_ko: 빛의 색: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Color or color-temperature relation of declared illumination and its receivers, separate from local pigment or grading.

light_direction.description: Incident light direction relative to a declared receiver and coordinate frame.
light_direction.description_ko: 지정 대상과 기준축에 대한 입사 방향: 카메라 방향·빛무늬와 구별; 배우 기준과 화면 기준 명시
excludes: 카메라 방향·빛무늬와 구별; 배우 기준과 화면 기준 명시
includes: Incident light direction relative to a declared receiver and coordinate frame.

light_intensity.description: Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.
light_intensity.description_ko: 대상에 도달하는 빛의 수준과 대비: 노출·톤 보존·클리핑·bloom이 섞임; image tone·optical artifact와 구별
excludes: 노출·톤 보존·클리핑·bloom이 섞임; image tone·optical artifact와 구별
includes: Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.

light_quality.description: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.
light_quality.description_ko: 빛의 경계와 광질: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
A source device name or ambiguous named lighting look alone does not establish softness, angular extent or shadow transition.
includes: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.

light_shape.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
light_shape.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

light_type.description: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.
light_type.description_ko: 광원의 종류와 발생 방식: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
excludes: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
A named day phase or lighting look alone does not identify a source type or emission mechanism.
includes: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.

lighting.description: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.
lighting.description_ko: 소유자·배치·광질이 연결된 조명 구성: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
excludes: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
A named lighting look alone, without positively declared source, placement and receiving-surface relations, does not establish a complete illumination setup.
includes: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.

location.description: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.
location.description_ko: 장면이 놓인 장소와 공간 구조: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
excludes: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
includes: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.

medium.description: Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.
medium.description_ko: 사진의 물리 매체와 이미지 지지체: 여행·패션은 genre; 셀피·CCTV는 촬영 구성; 플랫폼 용도와 분리
excludes: 여행·패션은 genre; 셀피·CCTV는 촬영 구성; 플랫폼 용도와 분리
includes: Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.

mood.description: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.
mood.description_ko: 장면이 제안하는 정서와 분위기 해석: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
excludes: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
includes: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.

motion_rendering.description: Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.
motion_rendering.description_ko: 영상에 기록된 움직임: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.

narrative_phase.description: Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
narrative_phase.description_ko: 명시된 인간·자연·기계 등 사건 안에서 선택한 순간이나 단계. 하루 시각·행사 명목과 구별하며 사건의 원인·완료·연속 경과를 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: Clock time, season, historical era and the name of an occasion alone.
An inferred preceding cause, unmentioned event, completed outcome or elapsed sequence.
Do not infer rainfall from wetness or a clock time from low tide; a phase requires its explicit source event relation.
includes: Explicit before/after/during relations and selected natural-event phases, including an already declared loading event, rainfall or tide.
Human participation is not required. Existing source conditions and actual event/carrier identity remain mandatory.
A procedure operation or material transformation can additionally have its own role; a selected event phase alone does not supply the operation or transformation.

occasion_context.description: Explicit occasion, ceremony or scheduled event shaping the scene, distinct from any arbitrary process step.
occasion_context.description_ko: 명시된 행사·계기·일정이 주는 상황: 현재 일반 준비·검토·작업 단계도 포함; 행사와 과정 시점을 구별
excludes: 현재 일반 준비·검토·작업 단계도 포함; 행사와 과정 시점을 구별
includes: Explicit occasion, ceremony or scheduled event shaping the scene, distinct from any arbitrary process step.

participant_role.description: Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.
participant_role.description_ko: 주·보조 구분 없이 이미 명시된 참여자의 참여상·관계상 역할. 외모에서 정체·직업·관계를 추론하거나 역할 이름만으로 상대역을 추가하지 않는다.
excludes: Off-frame placement, a back view and person count belong to their independently supported framing/count roles.
A rival/partner label does not itself create another participant or establish actual identity, occupation, disposition or a performed interaction.
Role truth and tag fit remain separate from effect permission; a prerequisite role cannot authorize a new role or relationship.
includes: A declared participant role can belong to either the primary or another existing participant. The source must identify the actual role carrier and any independently required relation endpoints.

physical_motion.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
